Container.Name: tesira-web-control
Container.Overview: Control Biamp Tesira main and subwoofer volume from a phone or tablet browser. Requires a reachable Tesira DSP with Telnet enabled. Set your instance tags and channel counts during installation, or change them in the dashboard. Gang links dashboard channel sliders; it does not change DSP block ganging. Trusted local networks only; no authentication. Preset selection is planned.
Container.Requires: Biamp Tesira DSP with Telnet enabled and network access to its control interface. Linux amd64 image.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: biamp tesira dsp audio volume canvas subwoofer

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Stores saved dashboard settings. Do not use the source checkout directory for a new installation.

Config.Name: DSP address
Config.Description: Required: your Tesira control-network IP address or hostname.

Config.Name: Main instance tag
Config.Description: Initial main-level instance tag. Case sensitive. Saved dashboard settings take priority.

Config.Name: Main channels
Config.Description: Initial number of main channels, 1 through 32; controls channels 1 through N.

Config.Name: Gang main channels
Config.Description: Initial dashboard linking: true sets channels together; false exposes individual sliders.

Config.Name: Subwoofer instance tag
Config.Description: Initial subwoofer instance tag. Case sensitive. Saved dashboard settings take priority.

Config.Name: Subwoofer channels
Config.Description: Initial number of subwoofer channels, 1 through 32.

Config.Name: Gang subwoofer channels
Config.Description: Initial dashboard linking for the subwoofer channels.

Config.Name: Main maximum dB
Config.Description: Maximum allowed main volume; match your DSP block limits.

Config.Name: Subwoofer maximum dB
Config.Description: Maximum allowed subwoofer volume; match your DSP block limits.

Config.Name: App user ID
Config.Description: Non-root UID that owns saved settings.

Config.Name: App group ID
Config.Description: Non-root GID that owns saved settings.
